text: Name greps found nothing; the rules may be CSS rules using different words. Search for 'feed' and css/scss files with div selectors.
command: cd /work && grep -rIliE 'feed' apps platform domains functions tools tests --include=*.css --include=*.scss --include=*.tsx --include=*.html --include=*.ts --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git 2>/dev/null | head -30; find . -name '*.css' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -30
